messages:
ana: heads-up — we need final sign-off on the new price sheet (PS-2026-03) before we flip the experiment next Wed. Can finance + billing confirm invoice/backfill approach? :eyes:

mike: thanks. is this the plan that applies a soft-grandfather for reserved customers (no immediate charge bump, just new rates on renewal)?

ana: yes — soft-grandfather for 60 days, then new rates on next commit. we also want a small promo for opt-in cohorts (5% credit for 30 days) to measure retention.

jess: for Stripe metered billing — we can send an invoice delta for accounts with usage after go-live, but need to decide on proration semantics. do we prorate for the remainder of the billing cycle or give a one-time credit?

rebecca: prefer one-time credit for simplicity. proration creates too many invoice adjustments and support tickets. can RevOps live with credits?

olivia: legal flag — ensure promo language and grandfather promise are in the billing T&Cs. i can draft a short addendum. will need to route through contracts for any customers on custom terms.

sandeep: on the runtime side, we need a header and a model routing toggle. suggest header: X-Redwood-Price-Version: "PS-2026-03". also adding an opt-in flag in /v1/accounts PATCH so product can flip cohorts. sample rollout snippet below:
```
rollout: {
  experiment_id: "exp-pricing-2026-03",
  cohorts: ["opt-in-promo", "control"],
  grandfather_days: 60,
  promo_credit_amount: "5%",
  effective_date: "2026-04-01T00:00:00Z"
}
```

mike: sandeep — can you also emit a Trace metric when price-version header is seen? product wants daily breakdown by cohort.

sandeep: yes — adding trace and metric. estimate 1 day of work (API + dashboard hook).

jess: to align invoices to vendors: important Q — vendor partner discounts (Marketplace) need to map to new price tiers. who owns mapping? finance or partnerships?

ana: partnerships should confirm mapping. rebecca — loop in vendor ops for AWS Marketplace SKU alignment. we cannot backfill vendor discounts retroactively.

rebecca: looping vendor-ops now. i'll ask them to confirm SKU -> PS-2026-03 mapping by Tue EOD.

billing-bot: Reminder: upcoming billing calendar lock for 2026-03-30 22:00 UTC. Any price-sheet changes after lock will apply next cycle.

ana: action items: 1) finance sign-off on credits vs prorate (jess + ana) — deadline Fri EOD. 2) partnerships confirm vendor SKU mapping (rebecca) — Tue EOD. 3) eng implements header + metric (sandeep) — PR by Mon. 4) legal draft addendum (olivia) — Wed. 5) product to prepare cohort evaluation prompts and MRR impact dashboard (mike).

mike: i'll own the evaluation dashboard and cohort analytics. will post a template by Mon.

jess: finance prefers one-time credit. will prepare credit ledger flow and FAQ for support.

olivia: i'll post the addendum draft in #legal for review.

rebecca: vendor-ops confirmed they can map 90% of SKUs automatically, 10% need manual review. that's ok for the timeline.

ana: perfect — thanks everyone. if we hit any blocker, escalate to me and we'll delay by a week rather than risk invoice mismatches. :+1:
